description: This is a Makefile fragment with conditional definitions for building libraries, package management tasks, and root filesystem preparation, specific to OpenWrt build system.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Defines the mklibs function for creating shared libraries, stripping, and copying sanitized libraries to destination paths.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Removes certain files from opkg info directories and cleans up the opkg status file.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Prepares root filesystem with default directories, runs post-install scripts, and cleans/sets timestamps.
